# [Implementation] - The REVIEW directive must quote the critique binary it actually resolved

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #314 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Precondition: each block is self-contained and run from the worktree root, in order. Blocks 1–2 write
only under the sanctioned sandbox `/tmp/opencode`; block 4 uses a fake `HOME` there so the real user
profile is never read or written. Every check exits non-zero with a diagnostic on failure. `dist/` is
untracked and must never be committed.

#### Check 1 — Build, then seed a REVIEW checkpoint with a resolvable bundled binary

```bash
npm run build
export SMOKE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-314-smoke
rm -rf "$SMOKE_DIR"
mkdir -p "$SMOKE_DIR/.agyloop/tasks" "$SMOKE_DIR/bin"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const dir = process.env.SMOKE_DIR;
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(
  `${dir}/.agyloop/tasks/314.json`,
  JSON.stringify({
    version: "1.0.0",
    currentStage: "REVIEW",
    mode: "standard",
    issue: 314,
    baseBranch: "main",
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    history: [{ stage: "REVIEW", timestamp: now }],
    pausedAtGate: null,
    pausedAtTimestamp: null,
    reviewDispatchCount: 0
  }, null, 2)
);
fs.writeFileSync(`${dir}/bin/critique.js`, "#!/usr/bin/env node\n");
console.log("S1 PASS: seeded a REVIEW checkpoint and a bundled bin/critique.js in " + dir);
'
```

#### Check 2 — The dispatched REVIEW directive quotes the resolved path and exports no PATH

```bash
export SMOKE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-314-smoke
export REPO_ROOT="$PWD"
( cd "$SMOKE_DIR" && node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 314 --json ) > "$SMOKE_DIR/next.json"
node -e '
const fs = require("node:fs");
const dir = process.env.SMOKE_DIR;
const out = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${dir}/next.json`, "utf8"));
const prompt = out.invocationPayload.Subagents[0].Prompt;
const expected = `node \x27${dir}/bin/critique.js\x27 --json`;
if (out.role !== "reviewer") { console.error(`S2 FAIL: expected the reviewer directive, got role ${out.role}`); process.exit(1); }
if (!prompt.includes(expected)) { console.error(`S2 FAIL: Tier 1 must quote ${expected}\n---\n${prompt}`); process.exit(1); }
if (prompt.includes("export PATH=")) { console.error("S2 FAIL: the PATH export still advertises ~/.local/bin\n---\n" + prompt); process.exit(1); }
if (prompt.includes("~/.local/bin/critique --json")) { console.error("S2 FAIL: the dead fallback command is still rendered\n---\n" + prompt); process.exit(1); }
console.log("S2 PASS: the REVIEW prompt quotes the resolved path and has no PATH export");
'
```

#### Check 3 — Resolved `.js` runs through `node`; the fallback is a discovery instruction

```bash
node -e '
const { ResolveSubagentUseCase } = require("./dist/application");
const none = { resolveReviewer: () => ({ source: "none", path: null, isAvailable: false }), review: async () => ({}) };
const resolvedJs = "/home/reviewer/.local/share/critique/bin/critique.js";
const userData = { resolveReviewer: () => ({ source: "user_data", path: resolvedJs, isAvailable: true }), review: async () => ({}) };
const unresolved = new ResolveSubagentUseCase({ get: () => null }, undefined, undefined, none).buildReviewerTaskPrompt({ issueNumber: 314 });
const resolved = new ResolveSubagentUseCase({ get: () => null }, undefined, undefined, userData).buildReviewerTaskPrompt({ issueNumber: 314 });
const failures = [];
if (!unresolved.includes("codeloop critique status")) failures.push("fallback does not name `codeloop critique status`");
if (!unresolved.includes("~/.local/share/critique")) failures.push("fallback does not name the user-data search location");
if (unresolved.includes("~/.local/bin/critique --json")) failures.push("fallback still quotes the dead path as the command");
if (unresolved.includes("export PATH=")) failures.push("fallback still exports ~/.local/bin on PATH");
if (!resolved.includes(`node \x27${resolvedJs}\x27 --json`)) failures.push("a resolved .js binary is not run through node");
if (resolved.includes("export PATH=")) failures.push("the resolved render still exports PATH");
if (!resolved.includes("Any `critical` or `error` findings mandate `REVIEW_STATUS: CHANGES_REQUESTED`")) failures.push("the Tier 1 severity invariant was lost");
if (failures.length > 0) { console.error("S3 FAIL: " + failures.join("; ") + "\n---\n" + unresolved); process.exit(1); }
console.log("S3 PASS: resolved paths are exact and .js runs through node; the fallback is a discovery instruction");
'
```

#### Check 4 — The real gateway's installer layout (`user_data`) reaches the prompt

```bash
export SMOKE_ROOT=/tmp/opencode/agyloop-314-home
rm -rf "$SMOKE_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$SMOKE_ROOT/home/.local/share/critique/bin"
export SMOKE_HOME="$SMOKE_ROOT/home"
printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' > "$SMOKE_HOME/.local/share/critique/bin/critique.js"
HOME="$SMOKE_HOME" XDG_DATA_HOME="$SMOKE_HOME/.local/share" node -e '
const { CliCritiqueGateway } = require("./dist/infrastructure");
const { ResolveSubagentUseCase } = require("./dist/application");
const workspace = process.env.SMOKE_HOME;
const gateway = new CliCritiqueGateway();
const resolution = gateway.resolveReviewer(workspace);
if (resolution.source !== "user_data" || !resolution.path || !resolution.path.endsWith("critique.js")) {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: expected the installer layout to resolve via user_data, got " + JSON.stringify(resolution));
  process.exit(1);
}
const prompt = new ResolveSubagentUseCase({ get: () => null }, undefined, undefined, gateway)
  .buildReviewerTaskPrompt({ issueNumber: 314, workspaceDir: workspace });
if (!prompt.includes(`node \x27${resolution.path}\x27 --json`)) {
  console.error("S4 FAIL: the prompt does not quote the user_data path\n---\n" + prompt);
  process.exit(1);
}
if (prompt.includes("export PATH=")) { console.error("S4 FAIL: PATH export survived\n---\n" + prompt); process.exit(1); }
console.log("S4 PASS: the installer layout resolves to user_data and the prompt quotes it");
'
```

#### Check 5 — Both static reviewer-prompt surfaces name the resolver, not a bare command

```bash
grep -q "codeloop critique status" prompts/reviewer.md
node -e '
const { DEFAULT_REVIEWER_SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT } = require("./dist/domain");
const prompt = DEFAULT_REVIEWER_SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT;
if (!prompt.includes("codeloop critique status")) { console.error("S5 FAIL: the default reviewer system prompt does not name the resolver"); process.exit(1); }
if (prompt.includes("Run \x60critique\x60")) { console.error("S5 FAIL: the PATH-dependent `Run critique` instruction survives"); process.exit(1); }
console.log("S5 PASS: prompts/reviewer.md and the embedded default both name the resolver");
'
```
